evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of a recent episode of fainting with transient loss of
consciousness.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 71 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 174 ms, QRS 94 ms, QTc
405 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with no acute ST-T wave changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
60%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

Fasting lipid panel this admission: total cholesterol: 225 mg/dL, LDL: 131 mg/dL, HDL: 44
mg/dL, triglycerides: 254 mg/dL.

BASIC METABOLICPANEL
Sodium: 135 mmol/L
Potassium: 3.8 mmol/L
Chloride: 104 mmol/L
CO2: 23 mmol/L
BUN: 14 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 160 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 9.9 mg/dL

Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily
Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Warfarin 5 mg by mouth once daily

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: 1+ pitting edema of both ankles.
